Those with me shall meditate and vibrate on the Lord of the Universe. ||6||","ms":"I would meet with my Lord and my fellow devotees too shall meditate on the World-Lord."},"pu":{"ss":"ਮੈਨੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰੱਬ ਮਿਲ ਪਿਆ, ਤੇ ਹੁਣ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਥੀ ਗਿਆਨ-ਇੰਦ੍ਰੇ ਭੀ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਨੂੰ ਹੀ ਯਾਦ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ ।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":4973,"next":4975}}
files.shabads/9/4975.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":4975,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1364,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58057,"last_verse_id":58058,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58057,"page_no":1364,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਹਮ ਬੁਰੇ ਹਮ ਤਜਿ ਭਲੋ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer sabh te ham bure ham taj bhalo sabh koi ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, I am the worst of all. Everyone else is good.","ms":"Kabir, I am the worst of all; except me, everyone else is good."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ!ਮੈਂ ਸਭ ਨਾਲੋਂ ਮਾੜਾ ਹਾਂ, ਹਰੇਕ ਜੀਵ ਮੈਥੋਂ ਚੰਗਾ ਹੈ;"}}},{"verse_id":58058,"page_no":1364,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਨਿ ਐਸਾ ਕਰਿ ਬੂਝਿਆ ਮੀਤੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੭॥","translit_en":"jin aaisaa kar boojhiaa meet hamaaraa soi ||7||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Whoever understands this is a friend of mine. ||7||","ms":"Whosoever realises thus, he alone is my friend."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਜਿਸ ਭੀ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨੇ ਇਸੇ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਝ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਕਰ ਲਈ ਹੈ, ਉਹ ਭੀ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਆਪਣਾ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਮਲੂਮ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ ।੭।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":4974,"next":4976}}
files.shabads/9/4976.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":4976,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1364,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58059,"last_verse_id":58060,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58059,"page_no":1364,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਆਈ ਮੁਝਹਿ ਪਹਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਭੇਸ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer aaiee mujheh peh anik kare kar bhes ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, she came to me in various forms and disguises.","ms":"Kabir, mammon came to me, assuming various garbs."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! (ਇਹ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਿਵੇਂ ਹੋਰਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਭਰਮਾਣ ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ ਤਿਵੇਂ) ਮੇਰੇ ਕੋਲ ਭੀ ਕਈ ਸ਼ਕਲਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਆਈ । "}}},{"verse_id":58060,"page_no":1364,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਹਮ ਰਾਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਨੇ ਉਨਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥੮॥","translit_en":"ham raakhe gur aapane un keeno aadhes ||8||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"My Guru saved me, and now she bows humbly to me. ||8||","ms":"My Guru saved me and she make me obeisance."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨੇ (ਇਸ ਤੋਂ) ਬਚਾ ਲਿਆ, ਤੇ ਉਹ ‘ਹਉਮੈ’ ਬਦਲ ਕੇ ਨਿਮ੍ਰਤਾ ਬਣ ਗਈ ।੮।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":4975,"next":4977}}
files.shabads/9/4977.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":4977,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1364,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58061,"last_verse_id":58062,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58061,"page_no":1364,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਸੋਈ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਜਿਹ ਮੂਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer soiee maareeaai jeh mooaai sukh hoi ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, kill only that, which, when killed, shall bring peace.","ms":"Kabir, destroy thou only that, by whose death, thou may be blessed with peace."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਇਸ ਹਉਮੈ ਨੂੰ ਹੀ ਮਾਰਨਾ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ, ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਇਸ ਦੇ ਮਰਿਆਂ ਸੁਖ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58062,"page_no":1364,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਭਲੋ ਭਲੋ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਬੁਰੋ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੯॥","translit_en":"bhalo bhalo sabh ko kahai buro na maanai koi ||9||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Everyone shall call you good, very good, and no one shall think you are bad. ||9||","ms":"Then every one shall call thee good and virtuous and no one shall deem thee bad."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹਉਮੈ ਦੇ ਤਿਆਗ ਨੂੰ ਹਰੇਕ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਸਲਾਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਕੋਈ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਇਸ ਕੰਮ ਨੂੰ ਮਾੜਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਆਖਦਾ ।੯।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":4976,"next":4978}}
files.shabads/9/4978.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":4978,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1364,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58063,"last_verse_id":58064,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58063,"page_no":1364,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਤੀ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਕਾਰੀਆ ਕਾਰੇ ਊਭੇ ਜੰਤ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer raatee hoveh kaareeaa kaare uoobhe ja(n)t ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, the night is dark, and men go about doing their dark deeds.","ms":"When the nights are dark, the men with dark deeds arise, says Kabir."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਜਦੋਂ ਰਾਤਾਂ ਹਨੇਰੀਆਂ ਹੁੰਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ, ਤਾਂ ਚੋਰ ਆਦਿਕ ਕਾਲੇ ਦਿਲਾਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਬੰਦੇ।"}}},{"verse_id":58064,"page_no":1365,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਲੈ ਫਾਹੇ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵਤੇ ਸਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੧੦॥","translit_en":"lai faahe uTh dhaavate s jaan maare bhagava(n)t ||10||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They take the noose and run around; but rest assured that God shall destroy them. ||10||","ms":"And taking nooses with them, they run about, however, know thou that they are the accursed of the Lord."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉੱਠ ਖਲੋਂਦੇ ਹਨ, ਫਾਹੇ ਲੈ ਕੇ (ਦੂਜਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਘਰ ਲੁੱਟਣ ਲਈ) ਤੁਰ ਪੈਂਦੇ ਹਨ, ਪਰ ਯਕੀਨ ਜਾਣੋ ਅਜੇਹੇ ਬੰਦੇ ਰੱਬ ਵਲੋਂ ਮਾਰੇ ਹੋਏ ਹਨ ।੧੦।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":4977,"next":4979}}
files.shabads/9/4979.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":4979,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1365,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58065,"last_verse_id":58066,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58065,"page_no":1365,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਚੰਦਨ ਕਾ ਬਿਰਵਾ ਭਲਾ ਬੇੜਿੑਓ ਢਾਕ ਪਲਾਸ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer cha(n)dhan kaa biravaa bhalaa beRi(h)o ddaak palaas ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, the sandalwood tree is good, even though it is surrounded by weeds.","ms":"Kabir, good is the sandal tree, even when it may be surrounded by the buteafrondosa trees."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਚੰਦਨ ਦਾ ਨਿੱਕਾ ਜਿਹਾ ਭੀ ਬੂਟਾ ਚੰਗਾ ਜਾਣੋ, ਭਾਵੇਂ ਉਹ ਢਾਕ ਪਲਾਹ ਆਦਿਕ ਵਰਗੇ ਰੱੁਖਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਘਿਰਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੋਵੇ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58066,"page_no":1365,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਓਇ ਭੀ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਬਸੇ ਜੁ ਚੰਦਨ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧੧॥","translit_en":"oi bhee cha(n)dhan hoi rahe base ju cha(n)dhan paas ||11||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who dwell near the sandalwood tree, become just like the sandalwood tree. ||11||","ms":"Those, who live near the sandal trees; they too become like sandal."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਹ (ਢਾਕ ਪਲਾਹ ਵਰਗੇ ਨਿਕੰਮੇ ਰੁੱਖ) ਭੀ, ਜੋ ਚੰਦਨ ਦੇ ਨੇੜੇ ਉੱਗੇ ਹੋਏ ਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਚੰਦਨ ਹੀ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ ।੧੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":4978,"next":4980}}
files.shabads/9/4980.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":4980,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1365,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58067,"last_verse_id":58068,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58067,"page_no":1365,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਬਾਂਸੁ ਬਡਾਈ ਬੂਡਿਆ ਇਉ ਮਤ ਡੂਬਹੁ ਕੋਇ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer baa(n)s baddaiee booddiaa iau mat ddoobahu koi ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, the bamboo is drowned in its egotistical pride. No one should drown like this.","ms":"Kabir, the bamboo, is drowned in its ego. Let no one drown oneself like this."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਬਾਂਸ ਦਾ ਬੂਟਾ (ਉੱਚਾ ਲੰਮਾ ਹੋਣ ਦੇ) ਮਾਣ ਵਿਚ ਡੁੱਬਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੈ;ਤੁਸੀ ਕੋਈ ਧਿਰ ਬਾਂਸ ਵਾਂਗ (ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚ) ਨਾਹ ਡੁੱਬ ਜਾਇਓ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58068,"page_no":1365,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਚੰਦਨ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟੇ ਬਸੈ ਬਾਂਸੁ ਸੁਗੰਧੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੨॥","translit_en":"cha(n)dhan kai nikaTe basai baa(n)s suga(n)dh na hoi ||12||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Bamboo also dwells near the sandalwood tree, but it does not take up its fragrance. ||12||","ms":"Bamboo abides near the sandal tree, however, it become not fragrant."},"pu":{"ss":"ਬਾਂਸ ਭਾਵੇਂ ਚੰਦਨ ਦੇ ਨੇੜੇ ਭੀ ਉੱਗਾ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੋਵੇ, ਉਸ ਵਿਚ ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਲੀ ਸੁਗੰਧੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਆਉਂਦੀ ।।੧੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":4979,"next":4981}}
files.shabads/9/4981.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":4981,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1365,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58069,"last_verse_id":58070,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58069,"page_no":1365,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਦੀਨੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਦੁਨੀ ਸਿਉ ਦੁਨੀ ਨ ਚਾਲੀ ਸਾਥਿ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer dheen gavaiaa dhunee siau dhunee na chaalee saath ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, the mortal loses his faith, for the sake of the world, but the world shall not go along with him in the end.","ms":"Kabir, for the sake of the world, man loses his faith, however, the world goes not with him."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਗ਼ਾਫ਼ਲ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨੇ ‘ਦੁਨੀਆ’ਦੀ ਖ਼ਾਤਰ ‘ਦੀਨ’ ਗਵਾ ਲਿਆ, ਦੁਨੀਆ ਭੀ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਨਾਹ ਤੁਰੀ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58070,"page_no":1365,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਇ ਕੁਹਾੜਾ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਗਾਫਲਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥੧੩॥","translit_en":"pai kuhaaRaa maariaa gaafal apunai haath ||13||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The idiot strikes his own foot with the axe by his own hand. ||13||","ms":"Thus, the ignorant man has struck his foot with an exe by his own hand."},"pu":{"ss":"ਲਾ-ਪਰਵਾਹ ਬੰਦੇ ਨੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਪੈਰ ਉਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਹੀ ਹੱਥ ਨਾਲ ਕੁਹਾੜਾ ਮਾਰ ਲਿਆ ।੧੩।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":4980,"next":4982}}
files.shabads/9/4982.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":4982,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1365,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58071,"last_verse_id":58072,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58071,"page_no":1365,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਜਹ ਜਹ ਹਉ ਫਿਰਿਓ ਕਉਤਕ ਠਾਓ ਠਾਇ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer jeh jeh hau firio kautak Thaao Thai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, wherever I go, I see wonders everywhere.","ms":"Kabir, wherever I went, I saw wonderful plays everywhere,"},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਮੈਂ ਜਿਥੇ ਜਿਥੇ ਗਿਆ ਹਾਂ, ਥਾਂ ਥਾਂ ‘ਦੁਨੀਆ’ ਵਾਲੇ ਰੰਗ-ਤਮਾਸ਼ੇ ਹੀ (ਵੇਖੇ ਹਨ); "}}},{"verse_id":58072,"page_no":1365,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਇਕ ਰਾਮ ਸਨੇਹੀ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਊਜਰੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਭਾਂਇ ॥੧੪॥","translit_en":"eik raam sanehee baaharaa uoojar merai bhaa(n)i ||14||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"But without the devotees of the One Lord, it is all wilderness to me. ||14||","ms":"however, without the devotees of the Lord, the world is a wilderness for me."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾ ਦਾ ਉਹ ਥਾਂ ਉਜਾੜ ਹੈ ਜਿਥੇ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਨਾਲ ਪਿਆਰ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ (ਸੰਤ) ਕੋਈ ਨਹੀਂ ।੧੪।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":4981,"next":4983}}
files.shabads/9/4983.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":4983,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1365,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58073,"last_verse_id":58074,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58073,"page_no":1365,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਝੁੰਗੀਆ ਭਲੀ ਭਠਿ ਕੁਸਤੀ ਗਾਉ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer sa(n)tan kee jhu(n)geeaa bhalee bhaTh kusatee gaau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, the dwelling of the Saints is good; the dwelling of the unrighteous burns like an oven.","ms":"Kabir, blessed is the tenement of the saint; the abode of the sinners burns like a furnace."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਸੰਤਾਂ ਦੀ ਭੈੜੀ ਜਿਹੀ ਕੁੱਲੀ ਭੀ (ਮੈਨੂੰ) ਸੋਹਣੀ (ਲੱਗਦੀ) ਹੈ,ਪਰ ਖੋਟੇ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਦਾ ਪਿੰਡ (ਸੜਦੀ) ਭੱਠੀ ਵਰਗਾ (ਜਾਣੋ) ।"}}},{"verse_id":58074,"page_no":1365,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਆਗਿ ਲਗਉ ਤਿਹ ਧਉਲਹਰ ਜਿਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥੧੫॥","translit_en":"aag lagau teh dhaulahar jeh naahee har ko naau ||15||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those mansions in which the Lord's Name is not chanted might just as well burn down. ||15||","ms":"Let fire prey upon those mansions, in which the Name of God is not."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਮਹਲ-ਮਾੜੀ ਵਿਚ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਨਹੀਂ ਸਿਮਰੀਦਾ, ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਪਈ ਅੱਗ ਲੱਗੇ (ਮੈਨੂੰ ਅਜੇਹੇ ਮਹਲ-ਮਾੜੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਲੋੜ ਨਹੀਂ) ।੧੫।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":4982,"next":4984}}
files.shabads/9/4984.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":4984,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1365,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58075,"last_verse_id":58076,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58075,"page_no":1365,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਸੰਤ ਮੂਏ ਕਿਆ ਰੋਈਐ ਜੋ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer sa(n)t mooe kiaa roieeaai jo apune gireh jai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, why cry at the death of a Saint? He is just going back to his home.","ms":"Kabir why wail at the death of a saint? He is merely going to his own Home."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਕਿਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਦੇ ਮਰਨ ਤੇ ਅਫ਼ਸੋਸ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਲੋੜ ਨਹੀਂ, ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਉਹ ਸੰਤ ਤਾਂ ਉਸ ਘਰ ਵਿਚ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਜਿਥੋਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਕੋਈ ਕੱਢੇਗਾ ਨਹੀਂ।"}}},{"verse_id":58076,"page_no":1365,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਰੋਵਹੁ ਸਾਕਤ ਬਾਪੁਰੇ ਜੁ ਹਾਟੈ ਹਾਟ ਬਿਕਾਇ ॥੧੬॥","translit_en":"rovahu saakat baapure ju haaTai haaT bikai ||16||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Cry for the wretched, faithless cynic, who is sold from store to store. ||16||","ms":"Weep thou for the wretched mammon-worshipper who is sold from shop to ship."},"pu":{"ss":" ਉਸ ਮੰਦ-ਭਾਗੀ (ਦੇ ਮਰਨ) ਤੇ ਅਫ਼ਸੋਸ ਕਰੋ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ-ਚਰਨਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੈ, ਹਰੇਕ ਹੱਟੀ ਤੇ ਵਿਕਦਾ ਹੈ ।੧੬।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":4983,"next":4985}}
files.shabads/9/4985.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":4985,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1365,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58077,"last_verse_id":58078,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58077,"page_no":1365,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਐਸਾ ਹੈ ਜੈਸੀ ਲਸਨ ਕੀ ਖਾਨਿ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer saakat aaisaa hai jaisee lasan kee khaan ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, the faithless cynic is like a piece of garlic.","ms":"Kabir, as is the piece of garlic, so is an infidel."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਜੋ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਰੱਬ ਨਾਲੋਂ ਟੁੱਟਾ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੈ,ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਇਉਂ ਸਮਝੋ ਜਿਵੇਂ ਥੋਮ ਦੀ ਭਰੀ ਹੋਈ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58078,"page_no":1365,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਨੇ ਬੈਠੇ ਖਾਈਐ ਪਰਗਟ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਦਾਨਿ ॥੧੭॥","translit_en":"kone baiThe khaieeaai paragaT hoi nidhaan ||17||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Even if you eat it sitting in a corner, it becomes obvious to everyone. ||17||","ms":"Even if one eats it sitting in a corner, it becomes manifest at last."},"pu":{"ss":"ਥੋਮ ਨੂੰ ਕਿਤੇ ਲੁਕਵੇਂ ਥਾਂ ਭੀ ਬਹਿ ਕੇ ਖਾ ਲਈਏ, ਤਾਂ ਭੀ ਉਹ ਜ਼ਰੂਰ (ਆਪਣੀ ਬੋ ਤੋਂ) ਉੱਘੜ ਪੈਂਦਾ ਹੈ।੧੭।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":4984,"next":4986}}
files.shabads/9/4986.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":4986,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1365,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58079,"last_verse_id":58080,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58079,"page_no":1365,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਡੋਲਨੀ ਪਵਨੁ ਝਕੋਲਨਹਾਰੁ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer maiaa ddolanee pavan jhakolanahaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, Maya is the butter-churn, and the breath is the churning-stick.","ms":"Kabir wealth is the churning pot and the breath is the churning staff."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਇਸ ‘ਦੁਨੀਆ’ (‘ਮਾਇਆ’) ਨੂੰ ਦੁੱਧ ਦੀ ਭਰੀ ਚਾਟੀ ਸਮਝੋ, (ਹਰੇਕ ਜੀਵ ਦਾ) ਸੁਆਸ ਸੁਆਸ (ਉਸ ਚਾਟੀ ਨੂੰ ਰਿੜਕਣ ਲਈ) ਮਧਾਣੀ ਮਿਥ ਲਵੋ । "}}},{"verse_id":58080,"page_no":1365,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮਾਖਨੁ ਖਾਇਆ ਛਾਛਿ ਪੀਐ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧੮॥","translit_en":"sa(n)tahu maakhan khaiaa chhaachh peeaai sa(n)saar ||18||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Saints eat the butter, while the world drinks the whey. ||18||","ms":"The saints eat the butter and the world drinks the butter-milk."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਹਨਾਂ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਨੇ (ਇਸ ਰੇੜਕੇ ਵਿਚੋਂ) ਮੱਖਣ (ਹਾਸਲ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇ) ਖਾਧਾ ,ਉਹਨਾਂ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਨੇ (ਇਸ ਰੇੜਕੇ ਵਿਚੋਂ) ਮੱਖਣ (ਹਾਸਲ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇ) ਖਾਧਾ ।੧੮।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":4985,"next":4987}}
files.shabads/9/4987.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":4987,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1365,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58081,"last_verse_id":58082,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58081,"page_no":1365,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਡੋਲਨੀ ਪਵਨੁ ਵਹੈ ਹਿਵ ਧਾਰ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer maiaa ddolanee pavan vahai hiv dhaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, Maya is the butter-churn; the breath flows like ice water.","ms":"Kabir, mammonish body is the churning-pot in which breath flows like the stream of iced water."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਇਹ ‘ਦੁਨੀਆ’ (ਮਾਇਆ’) ਮਾਨੋ, ਦੁੱਧ ਦੀ ਚਾਟੀ ਹੈ, (ਇਸ ਚਾਟੀ ਵਿਚ ਨਾਮ ਦੀ) ਠੰਢਕ ਵਾਲੇ ਸੁਆਸ, ਮਾਨੋ, ਮਧਾਣੀ ਹਿਲਾਈ ਜਾ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ । "}}},{"verse_id":58082,"page_no":1365,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਨਿ ਬਿਲੋਇਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਖਾਇਆ ਅਵਰ ਬਿਲੋਵਨਹਾਰ ॥੧੯॥","translit_en":"jin biloiaa tin khaiaa avar bilovanahaar ||19||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Whoever does the churning eats the butter; the others are just churning-sticks. ||19||","ms":"Whosoever churns, he eats the butter. Others, like the churning-rod obtain nothing."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ (ਭਾਗਾਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਮਨੁੱਖ) ਨੇ ਰਿੜਕਿਆ ਹੈ ਉਸ ਨੇ (ਮੱਖਣ) ਖਾਧਾ ਹੈ, ਬਾਕੀ ਦੇ ਹੋਰ ਲੋਕ ਨਿਰਾ ਰਿੜਕ ਹੀ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ।੧੯।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":4986,"next":4988}}
files.shabads/9/4988.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":4988,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1365,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58083,"last_verse_id":58084,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58083,"page_no":1365,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਚੋਰਟੀ ਮੁਸਿ ਮੁਸਿ ਲਾਵੈ ਹਾਟਿ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer maiaa choraTee mus mus laavai haaT ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, Maya is the thief, which breaks in and plunders the store.","ms":"Kabir, mammon, is a thief, who breaks into and plunders the shop."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਇਹ ਦੁਨੀਆ, ਇਹ ਮਾਇਆ, ਮੋਮੋ-ਠੱਗਣੀ ਹੈ ,ਠੱਗ ਠੱਗ ਕੇ ਇਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਆਪਣੀ ਹੱਟੀ (ਹੋਰ ਹੋਰ) ਸਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58084,"page_no":1365,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਏਕੁ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਨਾ ਮੁਸੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਬਾਰਹ ਬਾਟ ॥੨੦॥","translit_en":"ek kabeeraa naa musai jin keenee baareh baaT ||20||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Only Kabeer is not plundered; he has cut her into twelve pieces. ||20||","ms":"Kabir alone is plundered not, He is the one who has cut it into twelve pieces."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਉਹ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਇਸ ਦੀ ਠੱਗੀ ਤੋਂ ਬਚਿਆ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੇ ਇਸ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੀਆਂ ਬਾਰਾਂ ਵੰਡੀਆਂ ਕਰ ਦਿੱਤੀਆਂ ਹਨ ।੨੦।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":4987,"next":4989}}
files.shabads/9/4989.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":4989,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1365,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58085,"last_verse_id":58086,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58085,"page_no":1365,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਸੂਖੁ ਨ ਏਂਹ ਜੁਗਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਜੁ ਬਹੁਤੈ ਮੀਤ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer sookh na e(n)h jug kareh ju bahutai meet ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, peace does not come in this world by making lots of friends.","ms":"Kabir, making good many friends alone, one does not attain peace in this world."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਕਈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਣਾ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈਂ, ਇਸ ਮਨੁੱਖਾ ਜਨਮ ਵਿਚ (ਇਹਨਾਂ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾਂ ਤੋਂ) ਸੁਖ ਨਹੀਂ ਮਿਲੇਗਾ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58086,"page_no":1365,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋ ਚਿਤੁ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਨੀਤ ॥੨੧॥","translit_en":"jo chit raakheh ek siau te sukh paaveh neet ||21||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who keep their consciousness focused on the One Lord shall find eternal peace. ||21||","ms":"They, who keep their mind fixed on One God, ever attain unto peace."},"pu":{"ss":"ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਉਹ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਣਦੇ ਹਨ ਜੋ (‘ਦੁਨੀਆ’ ਵਿਚ ਵਰਤਦੇ ਹੋਏ ਭੀ) ਇੱਕ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਨਾਲ ਆਪਣਾ ਮਨ ਜੋੜ ਰੱਖਦੇ ਹਨ ।੨੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":4988,"next":4990}}
files.shabads/9/4990.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":4990,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1365,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58087,"last_verse_id":58088,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58087,"page_no":1365,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਰਨੇ ਤੇ ਜਗੁ ਡਰੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer jis marane te jag ddarai mere man aana(n)dh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, the world is afraid of death - that death fills my mind with bliss.","ms":"Kabir, death, of which the world is terrified, is pleasing unto my mind;"},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਜਿਸ (ਮੋਹ ਦੇ ਤਿਆਗ-ਰੂਪ) ਮੌਤ ਤੋਂ ਜਗਤ ਝੱਕਦਾ ਹੈ, ਉਸ ਨਾਲ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਵਿਚ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ੀ ਪੈਦਾ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ;"}}},{"verse_id":58088,"page_no":1365,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਮਰਨੇ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੁ ॥੨੨॥","translit_en":"marane hee te paieeaai pooran paramaana(n)dh ||22||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"It is only by death that perfect, supreme bliss is obtained. ||22||","ms":"it is in death alone, that one is blessed with the perfect supreme bliss."},"pu":{"ss":"‘ਦੁਨੀਆ’ ਦੇ ਇਸ ਮੋਹ ਵਲੋਂ ਮਰਿਆਂ ਹੀ ਉਹ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਮੁਕੰਮਲ ਤੌਰ ਤੇ ਆਨੰਦ ਸਰੂਪ ਹੈ ।੨੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":4989,"next":4991}}
files.shabads/9/4991.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":4991,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1365,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58089,"last_verse_id":58090,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58089,"page_no":1365,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਰਾਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਗਾਂਠਿ ਨ ਖੋਲੑ ॥","translit_en":"raam padhaarath pai kai kabeeraa gaa(n)Th na khol(h) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Treasure of the Lord is obtained, O Kabeer, but do not undo its knot.","ms":"Attaining to the Lord's treasures, O Kabir, open thou not its knot."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ!ਜੇ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਦੀ ਸੋਹਣੀ ਵਸਤ ਮਿਲ ਗਈ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਇਹ ਗਠੜੀ ਹੋਰਨਾਂ ਅੱਗੇ ਨਾਹ ਖੋਲ੍ਹਦਾ ਫਿਰ । "}}},{"verse_id":58090,"page_no":1365,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਨਹੀ ਪਟਣੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਰਖੂ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੋਲੁ ॥੨੩॥","translit_en":"nahee paTan nahee paarakhoo nahee gaahak nahee mol ||23||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"There is no market to sell it, no appraiser, no customer, and no price. ||23||","ms":"There is no city to sell it, no assayer, no customer and no price for it."},"pu":{"ss":"ਨਾਹ ਕੋਈ ਮੰਡੀ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਇਸ ਵਸਤ ਦੀ ਕਦਰ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈ, ਨਾਹ ਇਹ ਕੋਈ ਵਸਤ ਖ਼ਰੀਦਣੀ ਚਾਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਤੇ ਨਾਹ ਕੋਈ ਇਤਨੀ ਕੀਮਤ ਹੀ ਦੇਣ ਨੂੰ ਤਿਆਰ ਹੈ ।੨੩।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":4990,"next":4992}}
files.shabads/9/4992.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":4992,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1365,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58091,"last_verse_id":58092,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58091,"page_no":1365,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਰਾਮੁ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer taa siau preet kar jaa ko Thaakur raam ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, be in love with only that one, whose Master is the Lord.","ms":"Kabir, profess thou love for him alone whose Master is the Lord."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਉਸ (ਸਤਸੰਗੀ) ਨਾਲ ਸਾਂਝ ਬਣਾ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ (ਆਸਰਾ-ਪਰਨਾ) ਉਹ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਸਭ ਦਾ ਪਾਲਕ ਹੈ,"}}},{"verse_id":58092,"page_no":1365,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਪੰਡਿਤ ਰਾਜੇ ਭੂਪਤੀ ਆਵਹਿ ਕਉਨੇ ਕਾਮ ॥੨੪॥","translit_en":"pa(n)ddit raaje bhoopatee aaveh kaune kaam ||24||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Pandits, the religious scholars, kings and landlords - what good is love for them? ||24||","ms":"The scholars, kings and the landlords, of what avail is love for them?"},"pu":{"ss":"ਪੰਡਿਤ ਹੋਣ ਚਾਹੇ ਰਾਜੇ ਹੋਣ ਚਾਹੇ ਬੜੀ ਭੁਇਂ ਦੇ ਮਾਲਕ ਹੋਣ ਕਿਸੇ ਕੰਮ ਨਹੀਂ ਆਉਂਦੇ ।੨੪।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":4991,"next":4993}}
files.shabads/9/4993.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":4993,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1365,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58093,"last_verse_id":58094,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58093,"page_no":1365,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਇਕ ਸਿਉ ਕੀਏ ਆਨ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer preet ik siau ke'ee aan dhubidhaa jai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, when you are in love with the One Lord, duality and alienation depart.","ms":"O Kabir, the worldly love departs by loving the One Lord."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! (‘ਦੁਨੀਆ’ ਵਾਲਾ) ਹੋਰ ਹੋਰ ਸਹਿਮ ਤਦੋਂ ਹੀ ਦੂਰ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਇੱਕ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਨਾਲ ਪਿਆਰ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਏ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58094,"page_no":1365,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਭਾਵੈ ਲਾਂਬੇ ਕੇਸ ਕਰੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਘਰਰਿ ਮੁਡਾਇ ॥੨੫॥","translit_en":"bhaavai laa(n)be kes kar bhaavai gharar muddai ||25||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"You may have long hair, or you may shave your head bald. ||25||","ms":"It matters not, whether thou wear long hair or whether thou shave thy head clean."},"pu":{"ss":"ਚਾਹੇ (ਸੁਆਹ ਮਲ ਕੇ) ਲੰਮੀਆਂ ਜਟਾਂ ਰਖ ਲੈ, ਚਾਹੇ ਉੱਕਾ ਹੀ ਸਿਰ ਰੋਡ-ਮੋਡ ਕਰ ਲੈ (ਅਤੇ ਜੰਗਲਾਂ ਜਾਂ ਤੀਰਥਾਂ ਤੇ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਡੇਰਾ ਲਾ ਲੈ) ।੨੫।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":4992,"next":4994}}
files.shabads/9/4994.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":4994,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1365,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58095,"last_verse_id":58096,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58095,"page_no":1365,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਜਗੁ ਕਾਜਲ ਕੀ ਕੋਠਰੀ ਅੰਧ ਪਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਮਾਹਿ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer jag kaajal kee koTharee a(n)dh pare tis maeh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, the world is a room filled with black soot; the blind fall into its trap.","ms":"Kabir, the world is but a black chamber of the lamp-soot. The blind ones alone fall into its trap."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ‘ਦੁਨੀਆ’ ਦਾ ਮੋਹ, ਮਾਨੋ, ਇਕ ਐਸੀ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਕਾਲਖ ਨਾਲ ਭਰੀ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ; ਇਸ ਵਿਚ ਉਹ ਬੰਦੇ ਡਿੱਗੇ ਪਏ ਹਨ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਬੰਦ ਹਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58096,"page_no":1365,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੈਸਿ ਜੁ ਨੀਕਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨੬॥","translit_en":"hau balihaaree tin kau pais ju neekas jaeh ||26||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I am a sacrifice to those who are thrown in, and still escape. ||26||","ms":"I am a sacrifice unto those, who even when cast into it, escape unsoiled."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰ, ਮੈਂ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਸਦਕੇ ਹਾਂ, ਜੋ ਇਸ ਵਿਚ ਡਿੱਗ ਕੇ ਮੁੜ ਨਿਕਲ ਆਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ—(ਜੋ ਇੱਕ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਨਾਲ ਪਿਆਰ ਪਾ ਕੇ ‘ਦੁਨੀ’ ਦੇ ਮੋਹ ਨੂੰ ਤਿਆਗ ਦੇਂਦੇ ਹਨ) ।੨੬।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":4993,"next":4995}}
files.shabads/9/4995.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":4995,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1365,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58097,"last_verse_id":58098,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58097,"page_no":1365,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਇਗਾ ਸਕਹੁ ਤ ਲੇਹੁ ਬਹੋਰਿ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer ih tan jaigaa sakahu ta leh bahor ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, this body shall perish; save it, if you can.","ms":"Kabir this body must perish; if thou can, then save it."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਇਹ ਸਾਰਾ ਸਰੀਰ ਨਾਸ ਹੋ ਜਾਇਗਾ, ਜੇ ਤੁਸੀ ਇਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਾਸ ਹੋਣ ਤੋਂ ਬਚਾ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ ਤਾਂ ਬਚਾ ਲਵੋ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58098,"page_no":1365,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਂਗੇ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਤੇ ਗਏ ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਲਾਖ ਕਰੋਰਿ ॥੨੭॥","translit_en":"naa(n)ge paavahu te ge jin ke laakh karor ||27||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Even those who have tens of thousands and millions, must depart bare-footed in the end. ||27||","ms":"Even they, have to depart barefooted who has amassed millions and millions."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਬੰਦਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਪਾਸ ਲੱਖਾਂ ਕ੍ਰੋੜਾਂ ਰੁਪਏ ਜਮ੍ਹਾ ਸਨ, ਉਹ ਭੀ ਇਥੋਂ ਨੰਗੀ ਪੈਰੀਂ ਹੀ (ਭਾਵ, ਕੰਗਾਲਾਂ ਵਾਂਗ ਹੀ) ਚਲੇ ਗਏ।੨੭।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":4994,"next":4996}}
files.shabads/9/4996.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":4996,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1365,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58099,"last_verse_id":58100,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58099,"page_no":1365,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਇਗਾ ਕਵਨੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਲਾਇ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer ih tan jaigaa kavanai maarag lai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, this body shall perish; place it on the path.","ms":"Kabir, when this body has to depart, then put it on the good path."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਇਹ ਸਰੀਰ ਨਾਸ ਹੋ ਜਾਇਗਾ, ਇਸ ਨੂੰ ਕਿਸੇ (ਉਸ) ਕੰਮ ਵਿਚ ਜੋੜ।"}}},{"verse_id":58100,"page_no":1365,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਕੈ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੨੮॥","translit_en":"kai sa(n)gat kar saadh kee kai har ke gun gai ||28||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Either join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, or sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||28||","ms":"Either, associate thou with the saints, or sing thou thy God's praises."},"pu":{"ss":"ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਸਿਫ਼ਤਿ-ਸਾਲਾਹ ਕਰ (‘ਦੁਨੀ’ ਤਾਂ ਇਥੇ ਹੀ ਰਹਿ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ, ‘ਦੀਨ’ ਹੀ ਸਾਥੀ ਬਣਦਾ ਹੈ) ।੨੮।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":4995,"next":4997}}
files.shabads/9/4997.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":4997,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1365,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58101,"last_verse_id":58102,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58101,"page_no":1365,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਮਰਤਾ ਮਰਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਮੂਆ ਮਰਿ ਭੀ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਕੋਇ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer marataa marataa jag mooaa mar bhee na jaaniaa koi ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, dying, dying, the whole world has to die, and yet, none know how to die.","ms":"Kabir, dying, by one's turn, everyone has to die, and yet, none knows how to die."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਜਗਤ ਹਰ ਵੇਲੇ ਮੌਤ ਦੇ ਸਹਿਮ ਦਾ ਦਬਾਇਆ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ, (ਨਿਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਦਾ ਵਪਾਰੀ) ਕਿਸੇ ਧਿਰ ਨੂੰ ਭੀ ਸਮਝ ਨਹੀਂ ਆਉਂਦੀ ਕਿ ਮੌਤ ਦਾ ਇਹ ਸਹਿਮ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਮੁਕਾਇਆ ਜਾਏ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58102,"page_no":1366,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਐਸੇ ਮਰਨੇ ਜੋ ਮਰੈ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਮਰਨਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨੯॥","translit_en":"aaise marane jo marai bahur na maranaa hoi ||29||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Let those who die, die such a death, that they shall never have to die again. ||29||","ms":"Whosoever dies, let him die such a death, that he may not have to die again."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੋ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਜਿਊਂਦਾ ਹੀ ਮਰਦਾ ਹੈ (‘ਦੁਨੀਆ’ ਵਲੋਂ ਮੋਹ ਤੋੜਦਾ ਹੈ) ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਫਿਰ ਇਹ ਸਹਿਮ ਨਹੀਂ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ।੨੯।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":4996,"next":4998}}
files.shabads/9/4998.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":4998,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1366,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58103,"last_verse_id":58104,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58103,"page_no":1366,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਬਾਰੈ ਬਾਰ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer maanas janam dhula(n)bh hai hoi na baarai baar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, it is so difficult to obtain this human body; it does not just come over and over again.","ms":"Kabir, difficult to obtain is the human birth, it comes not again and again,"},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਮਨੁੱਖਾ ਜਨਮ ਬੜੀ ਮੁਸ਼ਕਲ ਨਾਲ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ, ਤਾਂ ਮੁੜ ਮੁੜ ਨਹੀਂ ਮਿਲਦਾ;"}}},{"verse_id":58104,"page_no":1366,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਉ ਬਨ ਫਲ ਪਾਕੇ ਭੁਇ ਗਿਰਹਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਲਾਗਹਿ ਡਾਰ ॥੩੦॥","translit_en":"jiau ban fal paake bhui gireh bahur na laageh ddaar ||30||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"It is like the ripe fruit on the tree; when it falls to the ground, it cannot be re-attached to the branch. ||30||","ms":"just as the ripe fruit of the forest, which when falls to the ground, attaches not again to the branch."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਵੇਂ ਜੰਗਲ ਦੇ ਰੁੱਖਾਂ ਦੇ ਪੱਕੇ ਹੋਏ ਫਲ (ਜਦੋਂ) ਜ਼ਮੀਨ ਉਤੇ ਡਿੱਗ ਪੈਂਦੇ ਹਨ ਤਾਂ ਮੁੜ ਡਾਲੀ ਨਾਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਲੱਗਦੇ ।੩੦।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":4997,"next":4999}}
files.shabads/9/4999.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":4999,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1366,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58105,"last_verse_id":58106,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58105,"page_no":1366,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰਾ ਤੁਹੀ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਤੂ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਉ ਕਬੀਰੁ ॥","translit_en":"kabeeraa tuhee kabeer too tero naau kabeer ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, you are Kabeer; your name means great.","ms":"O my God, Thou Thyself is great God and great is Thy Name."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! (ਸਦਾ ਇਉਂ ਆਖ—ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ!) ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਡਾ ਹੈਂ, ਤੇਰਾ ਹੀ ਨਾਮ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਡਾ ਹੈ । "}}},{"verse_id":58106,"page_no":1366,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਤਬ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਉ ਪਹਿਲੇ ਤਜਹਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥੩੧॥","translit_en":"raam ratan tab paieeaai jau pahile tajeh sareer ||31||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Lord, You are Kabeer. The Jewel of the Lord is obtained, when the mortal first gives up his body. ||31||","ms":"When man first abandons his bodily ego, then alone, obtains he the Lord's jewel."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੇ ਤੂੰ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਰੀਰ ਦਾ ਮੋਹ ਭੀ ਤਿਆਗੇਂ, ਤਦੋਂ ਹੀ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ-ਰੂਪ ਰਤਨ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ ।੩੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":4998,"next":5000}}
